description: This file defines a Perl module 'Git::Packet' that provides functions for reading, writing, and handling Git protocol packets over standard input/output, including capabilities exchange and packet comparison.

methods.name: packet_compare_lists
methods.description: Compares two lists of expected and result items for equality.

methods.name: packet_bin_read
methods.description: Reads a binary packet from STDIN, returning its size and content.

methods.name: remove_final_lf_or_die
methods.description: Removes a trailing LF from a buffer, dies if not present.

methods.name: packet_txt_read
methods.description: Reads a text packet from STDIN, expecting LF termination.

methods.name: packet_key_val_read
methods.description: Reads a key=value line and verifies the key matches.

methods.name: packet_bin_write
methods.description: Writes a binary packet to STDOUT.

methods.name: packet_txt_write
methods.description: Writes a text packet to STDOUT, appending LF.

methods.name: packet_initialize
methods.description: Performs handshake initialization with version and client/server labels.

methods.name: packet_read_capabilities
methods.description: Reads capabilities from the remote endpoint.

methods.name: packet_read_and_check_capabilities
methods.description: Reads remote capabilities and verifies required ones are present.

methods.name: packet_check_and_write_capabilities
methods.description: Verifies local capabilities against remote and announces capabilities.
